summary: Partial evidence, with stubs. At 07ffea7f89c5 (latest affected and fix parent), main with --clear_cache returned the seeded cached result, so the entry under the three-argument key survived. At the fix e1d2fa11d657 the run stopped with KeyError 'probe' at eval/compare_q.py:114, inside test_ppl. That line runs only if the cache entry was gone, but the probe did not register a loader, so the recomputation was not recorded as designed. A later attempt corrects the probe.
what_ran: repro.py imports unmodified eval/compare_q.py with third-party packages stubbed, seeds the test_ppl disk cache through the repository's disk_lru_cache decorator under the key of test_ppl(data_spec, spec, None), replaces get_test_data with a probe, and calls main with clear_cache true.
limits: No model or dataset was used. Imports of gptqmodel, aqlm, awq, vptq, bitsandbytes, transformers, exllamav2, datasets, matplotlib, adjustText, llama_cpp and gguf were stubbed, so this cannot count as a reproduction under the worker rules. logits_file was None; the out_logits path was not exercised.
